review_evidence: The README identifies the repository as a Lean 4 formalization from a PhD thesis on symmetrization of categorical groups and the categorical analogue of group abelianization.
The 10 formal-source files contain about 170 theorem/lemma/example declarations; representative results include dash.incS, dash_unit, len_dash, and FDMon_is_FreeDMon.
The formal development defines dashed words/monoids and proves the free dashed monoid universal property and rewrite/equivalence results, so it is direct mathematical prior art.
summary: Retain DashedMonoids: it formalizes free dashed monoids and categorical-group rewriting, including the universal property and substantial theorem development.
